items.title: 🧠 The Deal’s Done—Now What? 6 Steps to Get Contracts Under Control
items.summary: Contract signed? Great. Now the real work begins. In this guide, we break down the 6 essential steps every company needs to follow after signature to avoid risk, stay compliant, and turn agreements into action. From centralized storage and key term extraction to deadline tracking and team accountability—this is your post-signature playbook.

items.title: Turning Contract Chaos into Post-Signature Zen
items.summary: Docsum simplifies contract workflows from negotiation to post-signature tracking. Upload signed agreements, extract key data, and get timely alerts. Stay organized, reduce risks, and never miss a renewal again.

items.title: Why CLMs Fall Short on Contract Intelligence
items.summary: Most contract lifecycle management systems were built for routing and storage—not insight. In this post, we break down why traditional CLMs can’t deliver real visibility, how GenAI is changing the game, and what a modern contract intelligence platform should look like.

items.title: 🚀 Product Update: Docsum MCP, Legal Intake Agents + Metrics, and Enhanced Redlining
items.summary: Docsum's new MCP server lets AI agents like Claude securely query your contracts. The latest AI contract management update: Repository, Intake, and redlining.

items.title: 🚀 Product Update: Live Web Research, Document Templates & a Reimagined Word Add-in
items.summary: This release brings live web research into chat, custom document templates, and a Word Add-in that now matches the full web experience: file uploads, web research, unified login, and deep-linked citations, plus the latest security hardening.

items.title: 🚀 Product Update: AI Legal Intake & Playbook Generation
items.summary: Intake gets intelligent. This release introduces AI Legal Intake, an orchestrator agent that auto-executes requests, plus AI-generated playbooks with alignment scoring, a rebuilt Slack integration, automatic document grouping, and a unified notifications inbox.

items.title: 🚀 Product Update: Legal Intake, Inline Citations & Smarter Alerts
items.summary: Requests for legal come from everywhere: Slack, email, hallway conversations. This release introduces Legal Intake to capture and track them on a Kanban board, plus clickable inline citations, view-scoped chat, and value-based alerts.

items.title: 🚀 Product Update: Ask Your Entire Contract Repository Anything
items.summary: Until now, finding the right contract meant remembering where it lived. This release introduces Agentic Repository Search, so you can ask questions of your entire repository in plain English, plus chat attachments, AI signing detection, and faster bulk editing.

items.title: 🚀 Product Update: Document Relationships and AI Contract Editing
items.summary: Contracts rarely stand alone. Master agreements spawn amendments, SOWs reference MSAs, and renewals extend original terms. This release introduces Document Relationships—a system that lets you map how your contracts connect, surface composite values across linked documents, and see the full picture of any deal at a glance. We’ve also brought AI-powered contract editing directly into the Word Add-in, so you can draft and revise without leaving your document.

items.title: 🚀 Product Update: Configurable Alerts + Word Add-in Citations
items.summary: Never miss a critical contract deadline again. Set up custom alerts on any View, verify AI answers with paragraph-level citations in Word, and configure SSO without a support ticket. This release lets you configure custom email alerts on any saved View, trace AI-generated answers to source paragraphs in the Word Add-in, and set up SSO directly from Account Settings - no engineering required.

items.title: 🚀 Product Update: AI Chat in Microsoft Word + Bulk Document Type Changes
items.summary: We’ve added AI chat directly inside the Microsoft Word Add-in and introduced bulk document type changes to make negotiation faster and repository cleanup easier.

items.title: 🚀 Product Update: Entity Intelligence, Playbooks, Cloud Sync, and Enterprise Controls
items.summary: Docsum’s latest product update introduces Entity Intelligence, advanced contract playbooks, Google Drive and SharePoint sync, AI-powered contract identification, and enterprise-grade access controls. Legal, finance, and operations teams can now automatically organize contract parties, sync agreements from cloud storage, streamline contract review in Microsoft Word, and control access at the view level—all from a single contract intelligence platform built for modern organizations.

items.title: 🚀 Docsum Announces Catherine Cambridge as Strategic Advisor
items.summary: Catherine Cambridge joins Docsum as Strategic Advisor, bringing 10+ years of in-house legal leadership experience. A former General Counsel and Chief Legal Officer, Catherine has led legal operations, procurement, and compliance teams, and will help Docsum build trust with legal teams adopting AI-powered contract intelligence.

items.title: 🚀 Product Update: AI Chat & Contract Review Word Add-in
items.summary: Docsum has expanded its platform with two major capabilities: AI Chat and the AI Word Add-in, transforming it from a contract repository into a full contract intelligence platform. With AI Chat, legal, finance, and operations teams can ask natural language questions, uncover hidden insights, and receive clause-level answers with citations powered by Docsum’s unique entity and relationship intelligence. The AI Word Add-in brings contract review and negotiation directly into Microsoft Word, enabling users to apply AI-powered redlines, flag risks against playbooks, and reconcile counterparty edits without leaving their workflow. Together, these innovations help organizations accelerate reviews, reduce risk, and turn contracts into actionable business intelligence.

items.title: 🚀 Product Update: Document Relationships and Entities
items.summary: Docsum’s July 2025 product update introduces Document Relationships and Entity Management, transforming contract lifecycle management for legal, finance, and operations teams in the United States and worldwide. With Document Relationships, users can explicitly link related contracts—including Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Order Forms, Amendments, Renewals, and Terminations—creating a connected contract repository that makes it easy to answer questions like “Is this agreement still active?” or “Which documents are tied to this MSA?” The new Entity Management feature organizes all counterparty data, such as legal names, signers, addresses, and entity types (Vendor, Customer, Internal), allowing businesses to search, filter, and report on every agreement tied to a specific partner. By centralizing contract and counterparty tracking, Docsum reduces risk, streamlines compliance, and gives companies a single source of truth for audit-ready, modern contract management.

items.title: 🚀 Product Update: Email Uploads, Smarter Extraction, and Workflow Superpowers
items.summary: Effortlessly keep your contract library organized and actionable with our latest updates. Instantly upload documents by email, track every extracted value back to its original clause with clickable source citations, and receive redline analysis reports right in your inbox. Power users can now archive or reprocess documents in bulk, while smarter search makes finding the right agreement even faster. All wrapped in a refreshed, streamlined login experience—making Docsum smoother and more intuitive than ever.

items.title: Contract Chaos? How to Centralize Every Agreement Across Email, Google Drive, and DocuSign
items.summary: Tired of contracts buried in inboxes, Google Drive, or DocuSign accounts? This guide walks you through how to manually find every signed agreement across your business—and how to centralize them into a single, organized repository. Whether you’re prepping for a fundraising round, an audit, or just trying to avoid auto-renewal nightmares, this step-by-step process will help you regain control. Plus, learn why a solution like Docsum can save hours and reduce risk.

items.title: Product Update: Dashboard + More
items.summary: Unlock deeper contract visibility with our new Dashboard, delivering real‑time metrics and visual insights into active vs. expired agreements. Automatically classify every agreement by Entity Type (Customer or Vendor) and Status (Active, Inactive, Unknown), and keep your library clean with AI‑powered duplicate detection. Plus, easily share any view via CSV, preview PDFs inline with beta citations, and set document types on upload for perfect categorization—everything you need for smarter, faster contract management.

items.title: Unlocking the Power of AI for Smarter Contract Analysis with Docsum
items.summary: Managing contracts manually is slow, error-prone, and inefficient—but Docsum uses AI to extract key terms, track obligations, and streamline contract negotiations. With AI-powered search, automated clause detection, and real-time alerts, Docsum transforms contract management into a smarter, faster, and more data-driven process.

items.title: Product Update: Custom Fields
items.summary: We're excited to announce a major expansion of Docsum's data extraction capabilities, giving you more control and flexibility than ever before.

items.title: Product Update: Search + Document Types + Playbooks
items.summary: Docsum’s latest upgrade centralizes document types and integrates them with playbooks for seamless contract review. Soon, smart field extraction will automate key data capture, while enhanced search makes finding information faster and smarter.
